files.house-style.md:
# Wrenfield Press - house style sheet

Edition 4 of the style sheet applies to manuscripts submitted between 1 July 2026 and 30 June 2027.

## What changed in this edition
Hyphens are kept in compound modifiers before a noun.
Fiction and general non-fiction are both set in the same serif face.
files.submission-notes.md:
# Submitting to Wrenfield Press

Send the whole manuscript through the submissions portal.
The editorial office answers within three weeks.
Send one manuscript to one editor at a time.

turns.prompt: Wrenfield Press sets every accepted manuscript to the house style sheet. A manuscript reaches the press on 6 October 2026. Which edition number of the style sheet applies to it? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
